transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hello. ...I suppose I'm here because of some things going on lately. For months now, I’ve just been seeing this... pattern. 

I don't really know how much you need to know, but... my sister’s appointments keep getting moved around. Bills show up wrong. People conveniently forget to call me back. Everyone keeps telling me they’re just mistakes, but... I know what's actually happening. I know they’re keeping information from me. They're just trying to push me out of making decisions.
Aside from the things you've noticed with other people's behavior, have you been hearing, seeing, or sensing anything that others around you don't seem to notice?
No... no, nothing like that. I don't... I don't hear voices or see things that aren't there, if that's what you mean. It's just... what I already told you. The things people are doing. That's all.
Do you feel that these people are specifically targeting you, or do you believe this is part of a larger, more organized conspiracy involving people you don't even know?

I don't... I don't know about any grand conspiracy. I just know what I see happening around me. It's... the people I deal with. The ones involved in my sister's care and the finances. I don't think strangers are involved, if that's what you're asking. It's just... the people who have a reason to want me out of the way.

Has this feeling that people are trying to take advantage of you or keep information from you been a concern for most of your adult life, or is this something that only started happening in the last few months?

No, it hasn't been my whole life. Just... recently. It started about 11 months ago. That's when my sister's health took a turn for the worse, and I had to step in to start coordinating her care. That's when all this... started happening.
